Risk of Rain
Risk or Rain is a 2D procedurally generated game, me -a big fan of rouge-likes- is reluctant to write a review lest I make the game look bad, but 'ere we go.

First things first(at least for me), the level generation, is quite interesting, there are 6 levels, 11 maps total, out of which 4 levels have 2 map options and one level has a third option, though this one is secret -and pretty well hidden too.


Maps: so there's a 50/50 chance you'll either get the Desolate Forest(surname 'Ground Zero') or the Dried Lake('Ground Zero' too) for level 1, Damp Caverns('Fungal Heaven') or Sky Meadow('Field of Sprites') for the second level, the third level offers either the Ancient Valley('Frozen Tundra') or the Sunken Tomb('Underwater Catacombs'), for your fourth and final level with 2 potions you get the Magma Barracks('The Core') on the other hand is the Hive Cluster('Deep Undergrowth') and the secret map **** *****('****** *****'). Then the last two maps are obligatory, and difficult. Fifth level is Temple of the Elders('Ancient Ruins') and the *********************************. 

Enemies: every map offers it's on variety of enemies, which will leave you wishing you'd gotten the coin-flip otherwise. Some levels offer lots, and I mean lots of small enemies, which works better for you if you have certain items(for example the 'Heaven Cracker'), some feature predominantly larger, bulkier enemies(better Gordon Freeman up with that 'Crowbar'), but in either case, they're still out to get you, so you ought to deal with them however you can. Apart from the normal enemies, you also(if you choose to) have to deal with bosses, big, bad, bosses. One per level(difficulty affects numbers of both enemies and bosses).

Items: when it comes to items, there's a lot to talk about. First how to get them, you can buy them off shops, chests, the roulette, and shrines, they can also(rarely) drop off monsters.  The money to buy them with? Tough luck, you lost your wallet when you fell into this weird planet, you got to go all GTA on the monsters, kill them for money. There are its of items(a lot of them are unlockable through accomplishing certain challenges), and all of the items synergize quite nicely, which gives the game a good spice. There are at least 100 items(I can't remember exactly how many) that randomly drop, and are divided by tiers, white(common) green(uncommon), red(rare), yellow(rare boss drop) and purple(there are only 2 of these, and only one has actual use I call purple 'special'), from their tier you can imagine how powerful they are, that, and when you pick them up it tells you exactly what it does(most of the time). There’s(a lot) more about items that you should know, but you can check the wiki for that.

Artifacts: there are 10 artifacts, you select which you want to enable at the start of each game. I must say, these affect the game, a LOT, for example, Glass gives you 10% of your original health, but in exchange 500% damage, also there is command, which allows you to choose what items you want(from a set tier defined by the color of the chest), giving the game [i]even more[/i] replay value. These artifacts are found one per stage(discounting the secret stage), some are extremely well hidden, and some are not.

That’s all I care to remember right now.
92/100 in my personal opinion
